memories.content: The Chair is responsible for scheduling committee hearings. They are aware of the sixty-day window for the rail franchise bill and have discretion over the agenda. They have not yet decided whether to schedule a hearing.

The Republic of Valdoria's parliamentary transport committee is considering the rail franchise bill. The committee's rules allow a sixty-day window from the bill's referral to schedule a public hearing. The bill was referred to the committee on 2026-07-15, so the window ends on 2026-09-13. The committee has not yet scheduled a hearing as of the simulation start time. The Chair has the authority to set the agenda, but members can request hearings.
